subject.title: feat(agents): sessions_search tool for full-text recall over past session transcripts

question: Should direct `sessions.search` be an advertised `operator.read` RPC that can search the default agent without an explicit session-key allowlist, or should direct transcript search require a caller-derived allowlist or narrower scope before merge?
rationale: This is a new default, privacy-sensitive transcript discovery API; code review can verify the implementation shape, but maintainer intent is needed for the permanent gateway security boundary.

options.title: Require Allowlisted Search
options.body: Make direct gateway calls require authorized `sessionKeys` or an equivalent caller context, so broad transcript discovery stays behind the agent/tool visibility layer.

options.title: Accept Operator-Read Search
options.body: Keep the PR shape and document that full-text transcript discovery is normal trusted operator read access for this gateway.

options.title: Hold For Security Review
options.body: Pause merge until a security owner signs off on the read-scope and redaction model.

recommendation.title: Require Allowlisted Search
recommendation.body: Make direct gateway calls require authorized `sessionKeys` or an equivalent caller context, so broad transcript discovery stays behind the agent/tool visibility layer.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter owns the linked feature request and adjacent session-management product direction, and is the best available owner for this security/product boundary choice.
